title: Chapter 280
text:
Han Xiao's eyes sparkled. So far, the highest rating he had ever received was [Excellent], and [Unbelievable] was even higher than that.

If it were a normal player, the normal process of the mission would be like this: Infiltrate one base after another and steal information to find out the location of the other bases. As the Germinal Organization's alert level increased, the enemies they faced became stronger and stronger. Every time they got the information of the next base, they had to choose between destroying the base personally or using the Six Nations. The former had a higher reward.

However, he skipped the most complicated intelligence gathering operation and directly threw out the location of all the Germinal Organization bases. The difference in efficiency was like using a scythe to harvest and a tractor to harvest.

[Dust of the Fallen Seeds] was an A-level main storyline. Han Xiao had the advantage of being familiar with the storyline, but it still took him more than a year to complete it. It was almost like he had completed the final goal of the entire main storyline all by himself. Han Xiao was quite satisfied with the result and looked forward to the reward.

A new Legendary Point. Han Xiaoxin was certain. This was the reward he had expected. The maximum mission reward was increased by 5%, and the total daily reward was increased by 100%.

Soon, the interface was refreshed with other rewards.

The personal destruction progress was almost half. This meant that in the operation to destroy the Germinal Organization, Han Xiao's effect was almost the same as the entire army of the Six Nations. All the operations of the Six Nations were supported by his intelligence, and it could be said that the information he revealed had been influencing the direction of the situation.

This was an open scheme, using the Six Nations' hostility toward the Germinal Organization. As long as the Six Nations gave them a knife, they would do it. Even if the Six Nations knew that Han Xiao had the intention of killing them with a borrowed knife, they were willing to be used. In the end, Han Xiao and the Six Nations had achieved their goals.

"According to my mission evaluation, the probability of a random reward being a good item should be quite high." Han Xiao thought to himself. The Random Reward mechanism was to first draw a type of item, possibly an item, a skill, or something like that. Then, it would randomly draw a few rewards for the person to choose from. Only when the mission had a high evaluation would there be a chance for it to appear.

Putting the Random Reward aside, he first looked at the five special items.

You have received [Character Summon Card – Germinal Organization Leader]!

You have received [Character Summon Card – Destiny's Child]!

You have received [Character Summon Card: Aurora]!

You have received [Character Summon Card: Hella]!

You have received [Medal of Honor – Germinal Organization Burial (A)]!

Han Xiao was shocked. This was the first time he had received so many Character Summon Cards at once. The function of the Character Summon Card was to allow the user to release or temporarily possess the ability to summon a target. It was a trump card type consumable item, and if used well, it could instantly change the situation. He had only received two in the past.

Character Summon Card – Germinal Organization Leader: [Armor Piercing Combo] – All attacks released in the next eight seconds will be armor piercing critical hits, reducing the target's defense by 24%. Duration: 5 minutes. Usage: 0/12

Character Summon Card – Destiny's Child: [Future Peek] – Predict an 'opportunity'. Can specify items such as missions, items, a certain character's future actions, etc. Usage: 0/5

Character Summon Card – Aurora: [Life Return] – Instantly recover to full status. Usage: 0/6

Character Summon Card – Hella: [Whisper of the Dead] – Deals three psychic attacks to the enemy. Damage depends on the user's INT or MYS (can be specified). Reduces the target's status by 15%. Duration: 3 hours. Usage: 0/8

Only Destiny's Child's effect was not detailed. The other three were very simple and effective.

"Predict an 'opportunity', this meaning is very ambiguous … Could it be predicting the possibility of completing a mission and obtaining a specific item?" Han Xiao had a flash of inspiration. He had the idea of leaving Blue Star, but the methods that he thought of were not very reliable. This was a good opportunity to test out the effect of Destiny's Child.

Han Xiao did not hesitate and immediately used it. He silently thought about heading to the galaxy.

His vision suddenly blurred, as if it was filled with a dense fog. After an unknown amount of time, a smear of black color spread out in the center of his vision, turning into an unreal picture. The background seemed to be a wasteland. A flame fell from the sky, smashing a ring-shaped crater, emitting black smoke and electric sparks.

Some inexplicable information flashed through his mind.

"The location is … the time is …"

The image stopped abruptly, as if everything was an illusion.

Han Xiao came back to his senses, and the information had already been imprinted in his mind. His expression changed slightly, and he thought to himself, Indeed, it predicted an opportunity to head to the galaxy. This opportunity was originally one of the methods that I thought of, but I did not know the exact time. This card predicted a rough time and location, penetrating the fog of destiny, and seeing the timing of a certain event that I was looking forward to.

The effect of this card was very surprising, and Han Xiao was even more confident in leaving Blue Star.

He looked at the last item, [Medal of Honor — Germinal Organization's Burial (A)]. Completing a high-difficulty main storyline mission and obtaining a high rating would give this medal of honor. Its effect was an increase of all attributes by 3%. If he collected three of them, he could exchange them for a special achievement badge. The effect of wearing it was an increase of all attributes by 12%. He had obtained it before and knew that the effect was impressive, so he immediately put it on.

After calculating the special items, Han Xiao began to randomly give out rewards.

Randomly drawing … Your reward type this time is [Item].

Please choose one of the three items below.

Race Change Card: Randomly change your race.

Mission Completion Card (x3): Directly complete the mission and obtain the mission reward with the lowest rating.

Esper Potential Enhancement Fluid: Increase Esper Potential.

"Good stuff!" Han Xiao's eyes sparkled. [Esper Potential Enhancement Fluid] was extremely rare, and Espers were willing to go bankrupt to buy it because there were only two ways to increase one's Esper Potential. One was through rare experiments and potions in the game, and the other was the Esper Potential Enhancement Fluid. The other two were not suitable for him, so he chose the Esper Potential Enhancement Fluid and placed it on the interface.

Esper Potential Enhancement Fluid, be it sold to players or used by other characters, has a lot of potential value. I have to stock up on something like this first. It will definitely be useful in the future, Han Xiao thought to himself.

The reward this time was very bountiful. Although it did not seem like much, it was because Han Xiao's standards were too high. If it were a player, ten million experience was an astronomical figure.

There were also Potential Points, Attribute Points, and the reward items were all very useful, and Han Xiao was quite satisfied. The most valuable thing was the pile of items.

Dungeon Spawning: [Six Nations and Germinal Organization]

"What is this?"

Please select the main storyline to form the Dungeon Crystal.

"It can form the Dungeon Crystal!" Han Xiao's expression changed drastically, and he was pleasantly surprised.

After trying it for a while, he familiarized himself with the function. Simply put, it could turn many of his actions in the Germinal Organization's main storyline into Dungeons and generate Dungeon Crystals as rewards for missions. The benefits were self-evident, and it increased the variety of rewards he could give.

Han Xiao speculated that the reason for this new function should be because he could complete the main storyline with high difficulty with a high rating, which was equivalent to doing legendary deeds, and he could turn those deeds into Dungeons.

Some NPC missions might give him Dungeon Crystals. Dion, whom he had met before, had given him a Dungeon Crystal as a reward. Now, he had the same ability, and because of the existence of the interface, he could control the generation of Dungeon Crystals! He familiarized himself with it and realized that Dungeon Crystals could only be used as mission rewards and could not be directly turned into items to be sold in the shop. This was in line with the way players obtained Dungeon Crystals.

Compared to the other rewards, this function was the biggest gain! It strengthened his function as an 'NPC' and made him more attractive to players.

Han Xiao was pleasantly surprised.

"Only legendary experiences can create Dungeons. In other words, it can greatly change the main storyline of a planet or a larger area … The NPC template might have more functions, but I haven't triggered them yet."

Since the NPC template had this ability, it meant that the benefits of participating in the main storyline had increased.

If he could have the right to create Dungeons for many major events, the players would be unbelievably loyal to him.
